headline: Health Minister Mustafa Kamal said on Wednesday that the government is preparing a law to give Islamabad's PIMS hospital more financial and administrative powers, including a chief executive officer, after the August 26 fire at its nursery, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Hospital to get a CEO and more financial powers.

caption:
Big changes are coming to Islamabad's PIMS hospital!
According to Arab News, Health Minister Mustafa Kamal said on Wednesday that a new law will give the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) more financial and administrative powers, including a chief executive officer (CEO). The plan follows the August 26 fire at the PIMS nursery, in which 14 newborn babies died. The draft law will now go to Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif for approval. Current staff will keep their terms and benefits.
